text:
We sent a swarm of AI agents to solve Karpathy’s NanoChat benchmark, and they crushed SoTA in 3 days.

We built our own harness on top of a graph database to do auto-autoresearch, each iteration learning from mistakes to do research better.
The team wrote >15,000 entries. 🧵 https://t.co/tqlsCv5Qvp
